results.text: EXPLAIN shows whether a database query scans a whole table or uses an index. Slow queries often improve after an appropriate index, fewer scanned rows, and up-to-date statistics. Measure latency before and after each change.

metadata.title: Read a query plan before guessing

results.text: Hybrid search combines keyword full-text search and semantic vector search. Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked candidates inside the database. Exact product names and broader conceptual queries can both benefit.

A database index is like a book index. It lets a query locate matching rows without scanning every record. Index columns used in WHERE filters and JOIN conditions, then use EXPLAIN to inspect the query plan.
A database transaction groups related changes into an atomic unit. Commit when all steps succeed and roll back on failure. Short transactions reduce the time that locks block other work.

metadata.title: Finish a transaction as one unit

results.text: Embedding models represent text as numerical vectors. Nearby vectors often describe related meanings even when exact words differ. A vector database stores embeddings and retrieves nearby documents.
